title: Human's Stuff
description: A mod I made with stuff I want to add.
body:
This is a mod I made with stuff I want to add in Minecraft. 
- Launcher
  - The Launcher requires one Wind Charge. It has 3 enchantments, which increases the lauch height
- Slime Boots
  - The Slime Boots are boots made of slime(the render on your character is diamond.) You jump higher.
- God Food
  - This is a creative-only item that, when eaten, makes you OP
- Super Slime
  - Slime but you jump up higher
- Music Disks
  - A Tiny Spaceship Finale Mission and Steves Lava Chicken from 1.21.7. To listen without it cutting off, I reccomend Sinytra Connector and Jukebox Custom Disk Fix.
